business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and sells dyed fabrics and yarns, with a smaller garment manufacturing and sales segment.

segments.name: Production and sales of dyed fabrics and yarns

business_overview.revenue_model: Point-in-time sale of textile products and garments to customers; no individual customer contributed over 10% of revenue in 2024 or 2023.
business_notes: Core revenue was HK$4.426558 billion in 2024, broadly flat year on year; gross margin improved to 12.0%.
Manufacturing operations require inventories, receivables, plant, equipment and recurring capital spending.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Recent reported profit is thin and volatile. 2024 operating cash flow did not cover disclosed capital expenditure, while 2023 profit included a large one-off land resumption gain. Main analysis uses the 2022-2024 median parent net profit and applies a 0.35 cash-profit haircut.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash/deposits by holding company versus operating subsidiaries, nor by each jurisdiction beyond noting HKD, USD and RMB as main currencies.

2022 operating cash flow and capital expenditure were not extracted from the 2024 annual report; three-year cash conversion is therefore assessed with 2023-2024 cash-flow detail plus 2022 profit history.
No detailed deposit maturity schedule was found beyond classification as short-term bank deposits and note 23 interest-rate range.
